title: Every Word Echoes in This Town… Even 'HELP!' 🎤
description:
In this town, every word you say gets said back once! Dad yells PANCAKES and has to flip two, Mrs Patel's homework comes double, and Mr Gomez's whispers make the loudest quiet library ever. But when Rudy forgets his song on the big talent show stage, he whispers one little word… and the echo carries it all the way to the wings. 🎤✨

A short, kid-friendly story about asking for help, rivals who become friends, and how singing together is better than singing alone.
